messages:
alex: Heads-up — Sales wants a short-lived increase for a live demo tonight. They hit per-key throttles. Can we do a temporary allowlist for their demo key?

morgan: Which key and org? we need ticket + duration. Dont want to open broad burst windows.

alex: org=acme-corp, api_key=sk-prod-ACME-DEMO. Demo time 21:00 PST -> 22:00 PST (~1h). Sales asked for 3x burst for that window. Ticket #INC-4921.

samir: Can we instead do a scoped burst policy instead of full allowlist? e.g. allow 3x per-key burst but keep per-org steady-state limits. Safer.

katie: Agree with Samir. If we firewall only the key we still get visibility. Need audit log and TTL enforcement. Also need rollback if latency increases.

alex: Sales insists on immediate fix; they can't change client behavior. They prefer allowlist because simpler. They gave names for approval.

morgan: Ok, run through checklist: 1) TTL set 1h; 2) scoped to key; 3) telemetry enabled (trace sampling high for that key); 4) notify on error rate >1%; 5) require two approvers.

salesops: Approvers: @morgan + @katie. I can confirm from sales side.

support-bot: Auto-note: open support ticket INC-4921 created by alex at 2026-03-18T18:05:10Z.

samir: Quick config snippet I can apply via infra API:

```
PATCH /internal/rate-limits/keys/sk-prod-ACME-DEMO
{ "burst_multiplier": 3, "scope": "key", "expires_at": "2026-03-18T22:00:00Z", "reason": "sales demo" }
```

samir: This will keep per-org baseline and only lift token bucket temporarily.

katie: Add: set trace_sampling=0.5 for the key and enable `alerts:error_rate` -> channel #incidents.

morgan: Two approvals present. Alex, can you confirm sales acceptance of scoped burst not full org allowlist?

alex: confirmed. Sales accepts scoped key-only burst.

samir: I'll deploy the patch in 2 mins and monitor. Will ping here when live.

[~2 minutes later]

samir: Deployed. Patch ID: rl-patch-7821. Starting at 21:00 PST as requested (server time: 2026-03-18T21:00:00Z). Telemetry sampling increased.

katie: Monitor dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acme-corp/telemetry?window=1h&filter=sk-prod-ACME-DEMO — watching error_rate, p95 latency, token_usage.

alex: Sales: demo in progress, all green so far.

salesops: :tada: good job. Logging audit entry now.

samir: Noticed a small spike in p95 at 21:07 UTC+0 — looks like a client burst, but error rate stable. Keeping watch.

katie: If error rate crosses 1% for 5m we rollback automatically. I've set an automated rollback hook.

support-bot: Alert rule set: rl-patch-7821 -> rollback_on_error_rate = 0.01 (5m window).

[~50 minutes later]

samir: Patch expired automatically at 22:00. No incidents. Patch rl-patch-7821 closed.

alex: Thanks team. Can we add a one-click UI in Console for scoped demo bursts? Sales will keep asking.

morgan: Filed UX ticket: RED-UX-3387. Keep this thread for postmortem notes.

katie: Postmortem notes: good: scoped burst preserved org limits; telemetry helpful. Action: make TTL default 1h for UI flow, bake audit message template.

alex: tagging for next roadmap sync. :thumbsup:
